column1: # The merge of the event journal (the merge contract, common/contracts/events-merge.md): merge(participant, query, policies, epochs, resources) → the answer.
# input — the input of the function as JSON text (the package README); expect — a subset of the output: events — an array of rows in order, of a row are compared
# id, epoch_is ("@absent" — there is no field), fenced; the other keys — by value. A row: case<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note.

column4: note
duplicates by id — one; alarm before observation, within — newest; truncated — the sum of those that answered
a row's epoch below the current one, the policy fenced — epoch_is fenced, fenced true; the current one — current
the policy earlier-run — epoch_is earlier-run, fenced false
there is no row of the unit's epoch — current
a resource did not answer — incomplete did not answer, state «; srv-b unreachable», complete false
the door's row is not fresh — it is not asked: incomplete silent
a resource said not live — incomplete «said <state>»
the needed epoch is not read — incomplete <sub>/epoch did not answer, rows without epoch_is, fenced false (ADR-0091 addendum (27) item 2)
a worker, the epoch declared and read — the marking as at the console
a worker, the epoch not declared — epoch_is unknown, fenced false, complete does not change (ADR-0091 addendum (24) item 4, (27) item 2)
the declared testsub — fenced; the undeclared testsub2 — unknown
a worker, the declared epoch not read — incomplete <sub>/epoch, without epoch_is (not unknown)
keep oldest — in ascending t; the common limit 2: truncated = 4 answers + 1 not included
an equal t — id in ascending bytes
partial is carried over from the one that answered; lines_garbled — the sum of those that answered
the twin of limit-oldest at the worker: the worker's merge — steps 1–6 of the contract without 5а, the same outcome (ACC-VECTORS-CONNECT-03)
the twin of tie-by-id at the worker: the worker's merge — steps 1–6 of the contract without 5а, the same outcome (ACC-VECTORS-CONNECT-03)
the twin of partial-garbled at the worker: the worker's merge — steps 1–6 of the contract without 5а, the same outcome (ACC-VECTORS-CONNECT-03)
a grant by labels, the row of the unit c1 is unreadable — its rows are not visible, withheld [testsub/c1]; c2 with the label gpu — visible (C06-EVENTS-LABEL-SOURCE-138-07)
a grant on the unit itself — the row is visible with unreadable labels, there is no withheld
view on * — there is no filter, there is no withheld
a grant by labels is checked against the labels of the unit of (c1: gpu), not unit (c9)
there are no labels ([]) — the row is not visible, not withheld: the labels are known
